CommunityApplications.Profile:
Supla Power Monitor is a plugin for monitoring an energy meter (e.g. Zamel EFM-01) connected to [SUPLA Cloud](https://supla.org) through a public Direct Link — no OAuth, no login, just a single URL that returns live power/voltage/current/energy readings. It adds a native Dashboard tile showing live readings and a Settings page to configure the Direct Link URL and test the connection.
Maintained by KlimasTech. For support, use the forum thread linked below.
